content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Tacoma

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's detailed education and experience requirements to confirm you meet the baseline before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our online format accommodates Tacoma's working professionals—attend sessions from your home or office while learning from active certified practitioners across the nation.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, detailing your project-management experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee to unlock your eligibility window and secure your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides, to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center near you and demonstrate mastery of project-management frameworks and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Pursue continuing education, volunteer leadership, or advanced certifications to keep your credential active and your expertise current.
